pairing_rule: For each frozen target pair, use the registered partner actor with identical modality, vocal channel, emotion, intensity, statement, and repetition. For the same-actor statement control, flip only the statement code 01/02.
analysis_rule: Report each control minus aligned mean absolute error; retain all 240 paired rows, the 95 percent paired bootstrap interval, four actor-level means, and a four-actor cluster bootstrap interval. Do not infer population-level actor effects or select controls after scoring.
scope: Exploratory follow-up after the registered 2.0-second replay; it cannot retrospectively change the registered all-controls decision rule.
